# Zoo Style Guide

> The delta for the zooai org. Every shared convention lives in the canonical
> guide at hanzoai/styleguide, which is public and CC0; this file names only
> what is different about Zoo — the registry, the domains, where proposals and
> papers go.

## Canonical

- [Style guide index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanzoai/styleguide/main/llms.txt): commits, naming, comments, architecture, TypeScript, Go, whitespace

## Zoo

- [Zoo delta](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zooai/styleguide/main/README.md): org, registry, domains, ZIPs, papers
- [Licence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zooai/styleguide/main/LICENSE): CC0 1.0 Universal
